problem: Data display over time resolves UNDEFINED: bars for weekly minutes, a month heat grid and a 7-day sparkline (gap G1). The pack has no figure grammar for series, grids or trends, so cadence-dominion composed all three monochrome forms by hand (black fills, hairlines, grey ramp) and marked the improvisation.
insufficiency: resolve('bar chart of weekly minutes') -> UNDEFINED (closest: component/meter 4.0); resolve('calendar heatmap of the month') -> UNDEFINED; resolve('sparkline trend of the last week') -> UNDEFINED. search('chart')/'graph'/'data visualization' -> no hits. component/meter covers a single value (one track, one fill, one readout, D-15) — it cannot express series, month grids or trend lines, and no recipe composes them.
reuse_case: Histories, dashboards and weekly summaries recur in every tracker or admin consumer; cadence-dominion needed bars, a month grid and a sparkline on one screen (history + ritual detail). Without a declared grammar, each consumer re-invents baselines, value labels and the monochrome ramp slightly differently — the drift the authority exists to prevent.
composition_check: Rules, bands and labels compose surfaces, but no catalogue element declares a figure: no baseline, no series fill, no monochrome ramp, no trend polyline. The meter is single-value progress only. A full-kind search finds no candidate, so any in-character chart is currently uncanonical by construction — every use is an improvisation with a filed gap.
